findings.issue: Concrete checkpoint bindings in the reusable library
findings.resolution: Move both JSON bindings unchanged to experiments/evaluation/inference_correctness/fixtures. The library reader accepts an explicit file path. Update presets, CLI help and documentation. Historical frozen sources and artifacts retain their original paths. New replay commands use the explicit paths.
findings.validation: Byte-for-byte and SHA-256 identity; real CLI lookup found both unchanged manifests.

findings.issue: External numerical qualifications collapse into one comparison group
findings.resolution: When no recorded criteria/policy digest exists, preserve external command and evidence identities in comparison controls. Distinct commands or evidence now suppress relative throughput and reject a baseline recommendation.
findings.validation: Two public report regressions retain individually eligible trials but reject mismatched qualification comparisons.

findings.issue: GPU submission failure after manifest publication has no result/recovery path
findings.resolution: Track the acknowledged child handle separately from preparation. Preserve the actual prepared manifest and failure result. Charge zero only before submission or after confirmed NOT_FOUND; uncertain acknowledgement retains unknown cost. Refresh does not turn an empty unknown record into known zero. Recovery reuses the retained failure if the GPU job is absent.
findings.validation: Real coordinator/manifest/failure/recovery flow with fake external corpus I/O and Iris. NOT_FOUND and UNAVAILABLE cases remain reportable and cannot write an accepted recommendation.

findings.issue: Named runtime flags leave incompatible preset selectors
findings.resolution: Named mutually exclusive runtime flags replace the whole preset Runtime value, including stale opposite selector and revision.
findings.validation: Real plan CLI regression for both release-over-manifest and manifest-over-release, with fake HTTP/Hub I/O.

github_replies: pending source publication after final High GOAL review

recovery_cli_followup.trigger: Two real preparation-failed runs retained correct failed result states but the synchronous run CLI returned zero.
changes: Synchronous run preserves the report, then exits nonzero when its coordinator or GPU result failed.
Recovery avoids allocation capture for an absent GPU job, reuses the saved failure and returns nonzero.
Successful opt-in diagnostics may still exit zero with failed numerical checks; qualification is separate.

validation.public_cli_regression: The real recover CLI is exercised with failed coordinator and absent GPU job, including initially unknown submission status. External Iris/corpus I/O uses fakes.

recovery_cli_followup.scope_correction: The earlier collector-only regression did not cover allocation capture in the outer recovery CLI. This follow-up tests that boundary directly.
